title: Why Print On Demand Means Zero Inventory
desc: Print on demand explained: a fan orders, then it is printed and shipped. You never hold stock.

sentences.text: Stop buying two hundred hoodies you might never sell.
A fan orders. Then it gets printed, packed and shipped.
You never hold stock. You never pack a box.
That means no upfront bill for inventory, and no leftovers.
DIGITVL Stores connects to real Printful products, so you start with real catalog items.
